title: Ordinary coefficient square for a basic pair
statement: For fixed l,E,o,a, family X and integral inputs K, every BasicPair between expressions e and t has its ordinary reduction map followed by the system arrow equal to the reduction of the ringed arrow followed by the ordinary reduction of t.

source.place: Strict-system expression realization, generator square step.

proof.text: Transpose the equality through the reduction/limit adjunction and induct on BasicPair. Canonical isomorphisms, units and counits use mate identities; exchange and projection use the normalized proper mates; proper/open and compactification use their normalized pasting equations. Naturality and recursive ordinaryReduction finish each constructor.

proof_origin.place: The basic-pair component of the generator square.

mathlib_searches.results: The source plan contains this generic intermediate as a private helper in IntegralBasicGeneratorSquare; it cannot be imported directly because that module depends on the assigned exchange module.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Split as a named intermediate theorem.
